positive_change.result: Les éponges contribuent à maintenir la qualité de l'eau et régulent les nutriments au sein des récifs coralliens.
positive_change.beneficiaries: Les écosystèmes des récifs coralliens et les organismes qui y vivent bénéficient de l'activité filtrante des éponges.

fact_checks.sentence: Les éponges, animaux aquatiques simples dotés d'un squelette poreux, jouent un rôle important pour les récifs coralliens.
source_passages: Sponges — simple aquatic animals with dense, yet porous, skeletons — are highly adapted to their environments.
Regardless of these differences, sponges are important inhabitants of coral reef ecosystems.

fact_checks.sentence: Leur diversité de formes et couleurs participe à la complexité des habitats sous-marins.
source_passages: A variety of sponges dot the seascape of Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary.
From round to encrusting to branching, the colors and textures of sponges add to the complexity of the reef.
Sponges are found in a wide variety of colors, shapes, and sizes and are often mistaken for plants.

fact_checks.sentence: En filtrant l'eau, elles piègent bactéries et particules, filtrant ensuite le carbone, l'azote et le phosphore.
source_passages: A diverse sponge population can affect water quality on the reef as the sponges filter water, collect bacteria, and process carbon, nitrogen, and phosphorus.
As water filters through a sponge’s porous exterior, the sponge gains some motion, receives food and oxygen, and dispels waste.
Inside the sponge, tiny hairlike structures called flagella create currents to filter bacteria out of the sponge’s cells and trap food within them.
Their strong skeletal structures help sponges withstand the high volume of water that flows through them each day.

fact_checks.sentence: Certaines espèces, notamment dans les récifs pauvres en nutriments, libèrent du carbone transformé, ce qui nourrit d’autres organismes et préserve la productivité de l’écosystème.
source_passages: In nutrient-depleted coral reefs, some sponge species are thought to make carbon biologically available by excreting a form of “sponge poop” that other organisms feed on, thereby fueling productivity throughout the ecosystem.

fact_checks.sentence: Ce mécanisme aide à stabiliser la disponibilité des nutriments, la température et la luminosité, conditions cruciales pour la vie sur les récifs.
source_passages: In this way, sponges protect the reef against extreme fluctuations in nutrient density, temperature, and light, benefiting the survival of other reef organisms.

fact_checks.sentence: Cette capacité d’adaptation des éponges à différents substrats, qu’ils soient durs ou meubles, contribue à leur rôle stabilisateur dans ces milieux fragiles.
source_passages: A sponge’s skeletal type adapts well to its particular habitat, allowing it to live on hard, rocky surfaces or soft sediments such as sand and mud.
Some sponges even attach themselves to floating debris!
